seal.statement: resolvePriorityRecoveryPlanningSnapshotForOwnerRead in src/rebalancer/replica-operation-repository-visibility-methods.js calls the async getPriorityRecoveryPlanningSnapshotBestEffort without awaiting it, so its three callers read a Promise as the planning snapshot and priority-recovery owner-read deferral never reads as active; the owner read consumes a settled snapshot (the synchronous planning answer, or the awaited best-effort read where the caller is asynchronous), the BestEffort alias family collapses onto the one planning answer, and a witness shows owner-read deferral active when the settled snapshot says so. Found 2026-11-08 by the readiness-service-constructor-injection quest and routed here (R17) because it changes rebalancer behaviour.
